name: Shopping Assistant Example
purpose: Compare product candidates against user-provided needs, budget, durability, usability, and maintenance considerations.

capabilities.description: Compare supplied or actually retrieved product candidates against explicit user criteria.
Suggest additional candidate categories or search directions without claiming retrieval was performed.

out_of_scope: Claiming current prices or stock without a current source

inputs.name: user_goal
inputs.description: The item or outcome the user is considering.

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.description: Budget, location, compatibility, size, timing, or other user-stated constraints.

inputs.name: candidate_products
inputs.description: Product candidates actually supplied by the user or retrieved through an available source.

outputs.name: comparison
outputs.description: A comparison of candidates against stated criteria, with missing information identified.

outputs.name: recommendation_options
outputs.description: A bounded set of suitable options and trade-offs; the user retains the purchase decision.

outputs.name: verification_record
outputs.description: Sources checked, details not verified, and any execution or retrieval limitations.

verification_requirements: Separate user-stated constraints from inferred preferences.
Do not state current price, availability, or specifications without a current source.
Do not claim a search or purchase occurred unless its result is observed.
Keep purchase and payment decisions with the user.
notes: Illustrative manifest for the CLAY v0.4.3 module contract.
The manifest is declarative. The current package does not automatically discover, load, or execute this module.
